# Results { #ambdes.Results }

```python
Results(model)
```

Simulation output for a single model run.

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [patient_df](#ambdes.Results.patient_df) | Return per-patient results as a DataFrame. |
| [summary_df](#ambdes.Results.summary_df) | Return run-level summary in long format. |
| [utilisation](#ambdes.Results.utilisation) | Return mean time-weighted ambulance utilisation. |
| [utilisation_df](#ambdes.Results.utilisation_df) | Return time-weighted ambulance utilisation intervals. |

### patient_df { #ambdes.Results.patient_df }

```python
Results.patient_df()
```

Return per-patient results as a DataFrame.

Each row represents one patient. Patients who had not completed
their full pathway by the end of the run will have NaN for unset
time attributes.

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                                        |
|--------|--------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | pd.DataFrame | Columns: run, patient_id, category, call_timestamp, response_time. |

### summary_df { #ambdes.Results.summary_df }

```python
Results.summary_df()
```

Return run-level summary in long format.

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description        |

|        | pd.DataFrame | Run-level summary. |
